newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: Quake kills at least five in Afghanistan.
newsitem.headline: Quake kills at least five in Afghanistan.

text.p: Iran's killer earthquake also toppled a hospital wall in the western Afghan city of Herat on Saturday, crushing five people to death, a Red Cross official said.

"These are the only casualties we have confirmed, but this is a preliminary estimate as many parts of Herat and Farah provinces are very remote," Jean-Luc Paladini of the International Committee of the Red Cross told Reuters on Sunday.

The quake killed nearly 2,400 people in northeast Iran. On the Afghan side of the border it hit areas controlled by theTaleban Islamic movement, which accuses Tehran of supporting its opponents in northern Afghanistan.
